texts.preamble: M/S.Tamil Nadu Oil And Seeds ... vs Union Of India on 13 April, 2016 Bench: Sanjay Kishan Kaul, M.M.Sundresh In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras Dated: 13.04.2016 Coram : The Hon'ble Mr.Sanjay Kishan Kaul, Chief Justice And The Hon'ble Mr.Justice M.M.Sundresh W.P. Nos.22470 of 2012, 25595 & 25596 of 2011, 21965, 19477, 21726, 14083, 13897, 13908 and W.P. (Md) Nos.14281 of 2011, 6202, 8248, 7406, 9044, 9864, 10271, 10553, 10567, 4791 and M.P.No.2 of 2015, 1 & 2 of 2013, 1 &1 and 2 of 2013, 1 & 1 of 2014, 1 & 2 of 2014, 2 W.P.No.22470 of 2012 M/ s. Tamil Nadu Oil and Seeds Association, Rep. by its President, Sri.K.Paramasivam .. Petitioner -vs- 1.Union of India, Rep. by its Secretary to Govt., Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Nirman Bhavan, New Delhi. 2.The Commissioner of Food Safety of Tamilnadu, Dms Campus, Teynampet, Chennai. 3.The Authorised Officer, Food Safety and Standards Authority of India, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Shastri Bhavan, Chennai.
texts.arguments: 2.All the learned counsel for parties are ad idem that in pursuance to certain observations inter alia of the Hon'ble Supreme Court, an order was issued by the Government of India, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, dated 16.12.2014 constituting a Committee to undertake a comprehensive review of the said Act.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 2.All the learned counsel for parties are ad idem that in pursuance to certain observations inter alia of the Hon'ble Supreme Court, an order was issued by the Government of India, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, dated 16.12.2014 constituting a Committee to undertake a comprehensive review of the said Act.
